_comment: PRE-REGISTERED. These floors were fixed before any lineup-level result was
computed, and CI asserts this file's hash is unchanged. Loosening a floor to
make a demo look better is therefore a build failure, not a judgement call.
The possession floor comes from arithmetic, not taste. A lineup's offensive
rating has a standard error of about 115/sqrt(n) per 100 possessions. At 200
possessions that is +/-8.1, against a true between-lineup spread of roughly
6-8. Below 200 the measurement is noisier than the entire signal, so a point
estimate there is not a weak claim -- it is a meaningless one.
_ranking_comment: ADDED at version 2, for the play-ranking endpoint. No floor above was
every version-1 number by value, so the hash pin and that test together
distinguish an addition from a loosening. The confidence level below was
fixed before any ranking was computed, and before it was known whether any
two zones would separate at all.
_comparison_comment: ADDED at version 3, for the lineup-comparison endpoint. No floor above was
changed -- `test_the_floors_are_the_ones_the_arithmetic_implies` and
`test_the_ranking_thresholds_are_the_ones_pre_registered` assert every
earlier number by value, so the hash pin and those tests together
distinguish an addition from a loosening.
`omnibus_critical_value` is chi-square(0.80, 2), computed with scipy and
pinned here rather than evaluated at request time.
Two degrees of freedom, not eight. Every one of the five lineup terms
multiplies either the rim indicator or the three indicator and nothing
else, so a lineup's entire effect on the nine utilities is `a*rim +
b*three` -- a two-parameter family. The nine shares do live on an
eight-dimensional simplex, but a lineup has only two ways to move them.
Measured rather than assumed: on the zone-level covariance of the
difference, the top two eigenvalues carry between 99.94% and 99.997% of
the trace across the parity corpus, the third is three to five orders
below the first, and the condition number runs from 3e4 to 1.3e6. The
residual directions are second-order leakage, not signal, so an
eight-dimensional Wald statistic spends six of its degrees of freedom
inverting rounding error. Testing the two parameters the model actually
has is better conditioned and more powerful against the alternative that
was always two-dimensional.
A pre-registered critical value also means the Worker needs no incomplete
gamma function, which would have been the only special function in the
serving path.
The omnibus exists because nine per-zone tests at 80% manufacture a false
positive on most comparisons. It is fixed at the same 80% as the ranking so
that the two mechanisms cannot be read against different standards.
`min_profile_attempts` is the floor below which a player has no fitted
three-point or rim rate and silently inherits the league rate. Swapping such
a player in produces a delta of exactly zero for a reason invisible to the
caller, so the comparison refuses instead. It matches the floor the profile
fit already uses; it is written here so the serving contract does not depend
on a constant buried in the fitting code.
